description: This file implements a self-correcting, efficient timer ticker for burn-on-read countdown displays in Mattermost, managing subscribers and optimizing for visibility and drift correction.

classes.name: BurnOnReadTimerTicker
classes.description: A class managing a self-correcting, synchronized timer for burn-on-read countdowns, supporting subscription, visibility handling, and cleanup.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Adds a callback to be invoked on each timer tick; starts the timer if it's not already running.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a callback from the subscribers list; stops the timer if no subscribers remain.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the timer, sets up visibility change listener, and schedules the first tick.

methods.name: scheduleNextTick
methods.description: Calculates delay to align the next tick to the second boundary and schedules it.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Broadcasts the current timestamp to all subscribers if the document is visible.

methods.name: handleVisibilityChange
methods.description: Handles document visibility changes, triggering a tick when the tab becomes visible.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the timer and removes visibility change listener.

methods.name: getSubscriberCount
methods.description: Returns the current number of subscribers.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Stops the timer, clears subscribers, and resets state for testing or cleanup.
